========================================================================
NOTES ( Important, Read Me First ) 
========================================================================

1. LVS files are provided as working templates. 
Some modification may be required for additional devices or 
recognition/construction issues. 

2. This file is created by Calibre 20122-1711

3. This LVS has several metal options - 1P8M2T(default),1P7M2T,1P7M1T,... 
Removing double slashes ahead of #DEFINE TOP_METAL_ME7_1T 
switches the LVS to 1P7M1T, and so on. 

4. Warning! Do not turn on 2 or more metal options at the same 
time. If do that, a fatal error can occur. 

5. General Guideline for Resistor device extraction 
a. Marker layer should only cover the "body" of resistor, can not 
cover the contact/via of resistor terminal. 
b. For SAB resistors, the resistor marker should be flush with 
the edge of the SAB region. If the marker layer extends 
beyond the region, the resistance value will be higher 
than the actual value. 
c. The marker layer should exactly enclose the resistor body. 
d. General Guideline for pnp bipolar transistor extraction 
For each BJT should be covered by a individual BJT marker layer. 

6. The parameters of resistors have to be changed according to 
their layout width. Designers can discuss this with product 
engineers. 

7. Customers should revise the name of "runset.tec" to the correct	
LPE file name, and turn on PEXRUN,INCLUDE while running LPE file	

8. If customers don't want to do "ERC PATHCHK", please modify "LVS EXECUTE ERC YES" to "LVS EXECUTE ERC NO"
 
9. If your Calibre Version can not be compatible with XRC, please 
modify svdb output format from "XRC" to "XCALIBRE".

10. If customers would like to stop running when the tool detects the 
error in softcheck please turn on the option: "LVS ABORT ON SOFTCHK YES" 

11. For RCFLOW_CCI ,the layermap files are different for different 
option : HS HS_SP SP_LL LL SP HS_LL and MMC layer selected or not

12. If customer's design consists of more than 32 same devices connected 
in parallel,please turn on the option: "LVS PROPERTY RESOLUTION MAXIMUM ALL".
Please note that there is the potential performance penalty for it. 
In most circumstances, it should not be turned on.

13. Mark Layer:
MOMCAPS_SY_MML110AE:MOMSYMBOL
MOMCAPS_AS_MML110AE:MOMSYMBOL
VARMIS CAP:SIZE11
Inductor:SIZE6,SIZE7,SIZE8,SIZE9,SIZE10,SIZE11,SIZE12
Transformer:SIZE4,SIZE5,SIZE6,SIZE7,SIZE13,SIZE14,SIZE15,

14. If customers have SEPGND layer used, there might be many warnings without
turning on #DEFINE SEPARATE_GND. Therefore, please turn on #DEFINE
SEPARATE_GND switch when SEPGND layer is used and check the physical
connectivtiy of the designs.

// =================================================================================================
// Input and output Setup
// =================================================================================================

SOURCE PATH "test.spi"
SOURCE PRIMARY "test"
SOURCE SYSTEM SPICE

LAYOUT PATH "test.gds"
LAYOUT PRIMARY "test"
LAYOUT SYSTEM GDSII

LVS REPORT lvs_test.rep

//drc summary report "drc.rep"
//drc results database "drc.db"

UNIT LENGTH U
UNIT CAPACITANCE FF
UNIT RESISTANCE OHM
UNIT TIME US

PRECISION 1000
RESOLUTION 1


// =================================================================================================
// -------- LPE MASK SVDB define --------
// =================================================================================================

#IFDEF NONE_MMC
    #IFDEF PEXRUN
        MASK SVDB DIRECTORY svdb XRC
        ALLGATES = DIFF AND PLY_C 
        CONNECT ALLGATES PLY_C 
    #ELSE 
        #IFDEF PEXRUN_MC_HSPICE
            MASK SVDB DIRECTORY svdb XRC
            ALLGATES = DIFF AND PLY_C 
            CONNECT ALLGATES PLY_C 
        #ELSE 
            #IFDEF RCFLOW_CCI
                MASK SVDB DIRECTORY svdb CCI
            #ELSE
                #IFDEF RCFLOW_QCI
                    MASK SVDB DIRECTORY svdb CCI
                #ELSE
                    MASK SVDB DIRECTORY svdb QUERY 
                #ENDIF
            #ENDIF
        #ENDIF
    #ENDIF
    
#ELSE
    #IFDEF PEXRUN
        MASK SVDB DIRECTORY svdb XRC
        ALLGATES = DIFF AND PLY_C 
        CONNECT ALLGATES PLY_C 
        MMC_DUMMY = COPY CMMC
        CONNECT MMC_DUMMY CMMC
    #ELSE 
        #IFDEF PEXRUN_MC_HSPICE
            MASK SVDB DIRECTORY svdb XRC
            ALLGATES = DIFF AND PLY_C 
            CONNECT ALLGATES PLY_C 
            MMC_DUMMY = COPY CMMC
            CONNECT MMC_DUMMY CMMC
        #ELSE 
            #IFDEF RCFLOW_CCI
                MASK SVDB DIRECTORY svdb CCI
            #ELSE
                #IFDEF RCFLOW_QCI
                    MASK SVDB DIRECTORY svdb CCI
                #ELSE
                    MASK SVDB DIRECTORY svdb QUERY 
                #ENDIF
            #ENDIF
        #ENDIF
    #ENDIF
    
#ENDIF

//--------- LOD variable table ---------
VARIABLE LOD_INDEX	30

// -------- MOS MACRO --------
#IFDEF PEXRUN
    DMACRO MOSPROP_NORMAL DEVICELAYER PIN AUXLAYER AUX1{
        [
            Property W,L,AD,AS,PD,PS,SA,SB,NRD,NRS
            NRD=0
            NRS=0
            W=PERIMETER_COINCIDE(DEVICELAYER,PIN)/2
            L=AREA(DEVICELAYER)/W
            IN_D=PERIMETER_INSIDE(D,AUX1)
            IN_S=PERIMETER_INSIDE(S,AUX1)
            S=enclosure_vector(AUXLAYER,LOD_INDEX)
            SA=(((W/SUM(S::W/(S::A+0.5*L))-0.5*L)*0.9)-6E-9)/0.9
            SB=(((W/SUM(S::W/(S::B+0.5*L))-0.5*L)*0.9)-6E-9)/0.9
            IF(IN_S==0){
                AD=(AREA(D)*0.81*W/IN_D-0.0054E-6*W)/0.81
                PD=(PERIMETER(D)*0.9*W/IN_D-12E-9)/0.9
                AS=AD
                PS=PD
            }ELSE{
                IF(IN_D==0){
                    AS=(AREA(S)*0.81*W/IN_S-0.0054E-6*W)/0.81
                    PS=(PERIMETER(S)*0.9*W/IN_S-12E-9)/0.9
                    AD=AS
                    PD=PS
                }ELSE{
                    AD=(AREA(D)*0.81*W/IN_D-0.0054E-6*W)/0.81
                    PD=(PERIMETER(D)*0.9*W/IN_D-12E-9)/0.9
                    AS=(AREA(S)*0.81*W/IN_S-0.0054E-6*W)/0.81
                    PS=(PERIMETER(S)*0.9*W/IN_S-12E-9)/0.9
                }
            }
        ]
    }
    DMACRO MOSPROP_LD_N_LPE DEVICELAYER PIN AUXLAYER AUX1 AUX2{
        [
            Property W,L,NRD,NRS,AD,AS,PD,PS
            NRD=0
            NRS=0
	    NF=COUNT(AUX2)
            W=PERIMETER_COINCIDE(DEVICELAYER,PIN)/2*NF
            L=AREA(AUX2)/W
	    AD=(W*0.9/2+1.8E-6)*1.584E-6
	    PD=W*0.9+6.768E-6
	    AS=W*0.9*0.498E-6
	    PS=W*0.9+1.992E-6	
        ]
    }
    DMACRO MOSPROP_LD_P_LPE DEVICELAYER PIN AUXLAYER AUX1 AUX2{
        [
            Property W,L,NRD,NRS,AD,AS,PD,PS
            NRD=0
            NRS=0
	    NF=COUNT(AUX2)
            W=PERIMETER_COINCIDE(DEVICELAYER,PIN)/2*NF
            L=AREA(AUX2)/W
	    AD=(W*0.9/2+1.8E-6)*1.224E-6
	    PD=W*0.9+6.048E-6
	    AS=W*0.9*0.498E-6
	    PS=W*0.9+1.992E-6	
        ]
    }
    DMACRO MOSPROP_LD DEVICELAYER PIN AUXLAYER AUX1 AUX2{
        [
            Property W,L,NRD,NRS
            NRD=0
            NRS=0
	    NF=COUNT(AUX2)
            W=PERIMETER_COINCIDE(DEVICELAYER,PIN)/2*NF
            L=AREA(AUX2)/W
        ]
    }
    
    DMACRO MOSPROP_12HS DEVICELAYER PIN AUXLAYER AUX1{

                AD=(AREA(D)*0.81*W/IN_D-0.0036E-6*W)/0.81

            }

                                AD=(AREA(D)*0.81*W/IN_D-0.0036E-6*W)/0.81
                                PD=(PERIMETER(D)*0.9*W/IN_D-8E-9)/0.9
                                AS=(AREA(S)*0.81*W/IN_S-0.0036E-6*W)/0.81
                                PS=(PERIMETER(S)*0.9*W/IN_S-8E-9)/0.9
                            }
                        }
                    ]
                }
            #ELSE 
                DMACRO MOSPROP_NORMAL DEVICELAYER PIN AUXLAYER AUX1{
                    [ 	Property W,L
                        W=PERIMETER_COINCIDE(DEVICELAYER,PIN)/2
                        L=AREA(DEVICELAYER)/W
                    ]
                }
                DMACRO MOSPROP_LD DEVICELAYER PIN AUXLAYER AUX1 AUX2{
                    [ 	Property W,L
			NF=COUNT(AUX2)
                        W=PERIMETER_COINCIDE(DEVICELAYER,PIN)/2*NF
                        L=AREA(AUX2)/W
                    ]
                }
                
                DMACRO MOSPROP_12HS DEVICELAYER PIN AUXLAYER AUX1{
                    [ 	Property W,L
                        W=PERIMETER_COINCIDE(DEVICELAYER,PIN)/2
                        L=AREA(DEVICELAYER)/W
                    ]
                }
            #ENDIF
        #ENDIF
    #ENDIF
#ENDIF

//-------- Res. MACRO --------
DMACRO RESPROP_LPE DEVICELAYER PIN val_rend val_rs val_dw val_dl {
    [ 	Property W,L,res
        W = PERIMETER_COINCIDE(DEVICELAYER,PIN)/2
        L = AREA(DEVICELAYER)/W
        res = 2*val_rend/(0.9*w+val_dw) + val_rs*(0.9*l+val_dl)/(0.9*w+val_dw) 
    ]
}

DMACRO RESPROP_LVS DEVICELAYER PIN val_rend val_rs val_dw val_dl{
    [ 	Property W,L,R
        W=PERIMETER_COINCIDE(DEVICELAYER,PIN)/2
        L = AREA(DEVICELAYER)/W
        R = 2*val_rend/(0.9*w+val_dw) + val_rs*(0.9*l+val_dl)/(0.9*w+val_dw) 
    ]
}

//-------- MIMCAP MACRO --------

    [ 	Property W,L,cap
        L = perimeter_inside(DEVICELAYER,AUX1)/2
        W = AREA(DEVICELAYER)/L
        cap = val_Ca * (W*L) * 0.81 + val_Cp * 2 * (L+W) * 0.9 // calculate the cap value after shrinkage 
    ]
}

    ]
}

//-------- Diode MACRO --------
DMACRO DPROP AUX1 {
[
	PROPERTY W,L
	A = AREA(AUX1)
	P = PERIMETER(AUX1)
	W = (P-SQRT(ABS(P*P-16*A)))/4
	L = A/W
]
}

//-------- NCAP MACRO --------
DMACRO CAPPROP_LPE SEED AUX1_DEV AUX2_P val_lu val_wu val_cu val_c { 
    [ 	Property WF,LF,NF,cap
        NF = COUNT(AUX1_DEV)
        LF = PERIMETER_INSIDE (AUX1_DEV,AUX2_P) / (2*NF)
        Ammc = area (AUX1_DEV)
        WF = Ammc/LF/NF
        lu = (LF*0.9)*1e6 + val_lu
        wu = (WF*0.9)*1e6 + val_wu
        Cu = val_cu/( (LF*0.9)*1e6*(WF*0.9)*1e6 )
        cap = val_c*(lu*wu+Cu)*NF
    ]
}

DMACRO CAPPROP_LVS SEED AUX1_DEV AUX2_P val_lu val_wu val_cu val_c {
    [ 	Property WF,LF,NF,C
        NF = COUNT(AUX1_DEV)
        LF = PERIMETER_INSIDE (AUX1_DEV,AUX2_P) / (2*NF)
        Ammc = area (AUX1_DEV)
        WF = Ammc/LF/NF
        lu = (LF*0.9)*1e6 + val_lu
        wu = (WF*0.9)*1e6 + val_wu
        Cu = val_cu/( (LF*0.9)*1e6*(WF*0.9)*1e6 )
        C = val_c*(lu*wu+Cu)*NF
    ]
}

DMACRO CAPPROP_A SEED AUX1_DEV AUX2_P {
    [ 	Property WF,LF,NF
        NF = COUNT(AUX1_DEV)
        LF = PERIMETER_INSIDE (AUX1_DEV,AUX2_P) / (2*NF)
        Ammc = area (AUX1_DEV)
        WF = Ammc/LF/NF
    ]
}

//-------- MOMCAP MACRO --------
DMACRO MOM_SY_MMPROP DEVICELAYER AUX1 AUX2 AUX3 AUX4 AUX5 AUX6{
    [ 
        #IFDEF PEXRUN
            PROPERTY NF,L,NM,c2
        #ELSE
            #IFDEF RCFLOW_CCI
                PROPERTY NF,L,NM,c2
            #ELSE
                #IFDEF RCFLOW_QCI
                    PROPERTY NF,L,NM,c2
                #ELSE
                    PROPERTY NF,L,NM,C
                #ENDIF
            #ENDIF
        #ENDIF
        
        NF = COUNT(FNS)+2
        L = AREA(EXTLENGTH)/((2*NF-1)*0.2E-6)
        NM = 3+ (((COUNT(momlay4a)-2)/NF + (COUNT(momlay5a)-2)/NF + (COUNT(momlay6a)-2)/NF))
        
        cho_tb = 4.97e-16
        cv_tb = 1.1e-16
        ratio = 1.5
    IF(NM==6){ m6=1 }
    ELSE{ m6=0 }
    IF(NM==5){ m5=1 }
    ELSE{ m5=0 }
    IF(NM==4){ m4=1 }
    ELSE{ m4=0 }
    IF(NM==3){ m3=1 }
    ELSE{ m3=0 }
        
        factor = 1.2*m6 + 1*m5 + 0.794*m4 + 0.59*m3
        C = ((0.9*L)/(1e-6)*((NF-3)*cho_tb +2*ratio*cho_tb ) + (NF-2) *cv_tb) *factor
        c2 = C
    ]
}

                    #ENDIF
                #ENDIF
            #ENDIF
        #ENDIF

        BM = 2

        A5=(COUNT(momlay_b)/MH_A)-1
        A4=(COUNT(momlay_c)/MH_A)-1
        A3=(COUNT(momlay_d)/MH_A)-1
        A2=(COUNT(momlay_e)/MH_A)-1

        }ELSE{

            }ELSE{

        }ELSE{
            m2=0

        cho_tb_bm1 = 6.63e-16

        cho_tb_bm2 = 2.24e-16
        cv_tb_bm2 = 2e-17
        ratio_bm2 = 1.3

        c_bm2= (( L*0.9/(1E-6)*((NF-3)*cho_tb_bm2 + 2*ratio_bm2*cho_tb_bm2) +(nf-2)*cv_tb_bm2) * factor_bm2) -0.00184e-15*L*0.9 -0.03164e-15

	WRONG_PTAP

#IFDEF SEPARATE_GND
    ERC SELECT CHECK SEPARATE_GROUND
    SEPARATE_GROUND{@Please review if this place should have SEPGND layer and double check the connection of P-substrate in this area.
        FLATTEN SEPGND
    }
#ENDIF

WRONG_NTAP{@Check NTAP WITH WRONG TEXT GROUND_NAME EXCEPT DIODE and BJT and NCAP
    (NET NTAP GROUND_NAME) NOT INTERACT (((DSYMBOL OR BJTSYMBOL) OR NWR) OR NCAP)
}

WRONG_PTAP{@Check PTAP WITH WRONG TEXT POWER_NAME EXCEPT DIODE and BJT
    (NET PTAP POWER_NAME) NOT INTERACT (DSYMBOL OR BJTSYMBOL)
}

WRONG_TTAP{@Check TTAP WITH WRONG TEXT POWER_NAME EXCEPT DIODE and BJT
    (NET TTAP POWER_NAME) NOT INTERACT (DSYMBOL OR BJTSYMBOL)
}

WRONG_FLOATING_NTAP{@Check NTAP WITHOUT TEXT POWER_NAME GROUND_NAME EXCEPT DIODE and BJT and NCAP
	ntap_no_pwr = PATHCHK !POWER NTAP PORTS ALSO
	ntap_no_label = PATHCHK !LABELED NTAP PORTS ALSO
	floating_ntap_i = ntap_no_pwr or ntap_no_label
	floating_ntap_i NOT INTERACT (((DSYMBOL OR BJTSYMBOL) OR NWR) OR NCAP)
}

WRONG_FLOATING_PTAP{@Check PTAP WITHOUT TEXT POWER_NAME GROUND_NAME EXCEPT DIODE and BJT
	ptap_no_gnd = PATHCHK !GROUND PTAP PORTS ALSO
	ptap_no_label = PATHCHK !LABELED PTAP PORTS ALSO
	floating_ptap_i = ptap_no_gnd or ptap_no_label
	floating_ptap_i NOT INTERACT (DSYMBOL OR BJTSYMBOL)
}

WRONG_FLOATING_TTAP{@Check TTAP WITHOUT TEXT POWER_NAME GROUND_NAME EXCEPT DIODE and BJT
	ttap_no_gnd = PATHCHK !GROUND TTAP PORTS ALSO
	ttap_no_label = PATHCHK !LABELED TTAP PORTS ALSO
	floating_ttap_i = ttap_no_gnd or ttap_no_label
	floating_ttap_i NOT INTERACT (DSYMBOL OR BJTSYMBOL)
}

WRONG_FLOATING_WEL{@Check WEL WITHOUT TEXT POWER_NAME GROUND_NAME EXCEPT DIODE and BJT and NCAP
	nw_no_pwr = PATHCHK !POWER WEL PORTS ALSO
	nw_no_label = PATHCHK !LABELED WEL PORTS ALSO
	floating_nwell_i = nw_no_pwr or nw_no_label
	floating_nwell_i NOT INTERACT ((DSYMBOL OR BJTSYMBOL) OR NCAP)
}

WRONG_FLOATING_PSUB{@Check PWEL WITHOUT TEXT GROUND_NAME EXCEPT DIODE and BJT and PCAP
       	ptap_no_gnd = PATHCHK !GROUND PTAP PORTS ALSO 
       	ptap_no_label = PATHCHK !LABELED PTAP PORTS ALSO 
       	floating_ptap_i = (((ptap_no_gnd or ptap_no_label) NOT INTERACT (DSYMBOL OR BJTSYMBOL)) NOT TWEL) NOT NWEL
       	floating_ptap_j = NET AREA RATIO((PTAP NOT TWEL) NOT NWEL) PSUB_ALL > 0
       	floating_pw_1 = PSUB_ALL ENCLOSE (floating_ptap_i and floating_ptap_j)
       	floating_pw_2 = NET AREA RATIO PSUB_ALL PTAP == 0 
       	floating_pw_1 or floating_pw_2
}

WRONG_overlap_NPLUS_PPLUS{@Check overlapping for N+ and P+ layer
    (NPLUS AND PPLUS) AND DIFF
}

WRONG_DIFF_without_NPLUS_PPLUS{@Check Diffusion without N+ and P+ layer
	DIFF NOT (NPLUS OR PPLUS)
}

PATHCHK_GND{@To check nets with a path to ground not power
    PATHCHK GROUND && !POWER
}

PATHCHK_PWR{@To check nets with a path to power not ground
    PATHCHK POWER && !GROUND
}

PATHCHK_NPWRGND{@To check nets with no path to power and ground
    PATHCHK !POWER && !GROUND NOFLOAT
}

PATHCHK_NLABELED{@To check nets with no path to any labeled net
    PATHCHK !LABELED NOFLOAT
}

// Define Substrate

DRC:1 = EXTENT DRAWN ORIGINAL
BULK = SIZE DRC:1 BY 1.0
SEPGND_1 = SIZE SEPGND BY 0.001
SEPGND_2 = SEPGND_1 NOT SEPGND

PSUB_1	 = BULK NOT (NWEL OR TWEL)
#IFDEF SEPARATE_GND
//	PSUB_ALL = BULK NOT SEPGND_2
	PSUB = PSUB_1 NOT SEPGND_2
	PSUB_ALL = BULK NOT(SEPGND_2 NOT INSIDE TWEL)
#ELSE
	PSUB_ALL = COPY BULK 
	PSUB = COPY PSUB_1 
#ENDIF

TWELL1 = TWEL INSIDE NWEL
TWELL2 =(TWEL AND (HOLES NWEL INNER)) NOT TWELL1
TWELL_D = TWELL1 OR TWELL2
TWELL = SIZE( TWELL1 OR TWELL2 ) BY -0.001
NWELL = NWEL NOT TWELL
BPDIFF = DIFF AND PPLUS
BNDIFF = DIFF AND NPLUS
PGATE = BPDIFF AND PO1
NGATE = BNDIFF AND PO1 
BPGATE = PGATE NOT (PO_LVS OR PSYMBOL)
BNGATE = NGATE NOT (PO_LVS OR PSYMBOL)
RAMCELL = (((((((SPS OR DP_3) OR DP_6S) OR SPLLS) OR DP4S) OR DP3S) OR DP_6) OR SP_HSSP141) OR SP_LL141 

#IFDEF METAL_INCLUDE_DUMMY_LAYER
    // Metal Layer derivation
    ME1_ALL =( ME1 OR M1DUMY) NOT M1SLOT
    ME2_ALL =( ME2 OR M2DUMY) NOT M2SLOT
    ME3_ALL =( ME3 OR M3DUMY) NOT M3SLOT
    ME4_ALL =( ME4 OR M4DUMY) NOT M4SLOT
    ME5_ALL =( ME5 OR M5DUMY) NOT M5SLOT
    ME6_ALL =( ME6 OR M6DUMY) NOT M6SLOT
    ME7_ALL =( ME7 OR M7DUMY) NOT M7SLOT
    ME8_ALL =( ME8 OR M8DUMY) NOT M8SLOT
#ELSE
    ME1_ALL = ME1 NOT M1SLOT
    ME2_ALL = ME2 NOT M2SLOT
    ME3_ALL = ME3 NOT M3SLOT
    ME4_ALL = ME4 NOT M4SLOT
    ME5_ALL = ME5 NOT M5SLOT
    ME6_ALL = ME6 NOT M6SLOT
    ME7_ALL = ME7 NOT M7SLOT
    ME8_ALL = ME8 NOT M8SLOT
#ENDIF


// =================================================================================================
// Define Poly Resistor
// =================================================================================================

PYRES = PO1 AND PSYMBOL
SPYRES = PYRES AND SAB
HRPYR = (SPYRES AND HR) INTERACT PPLUS
NSHRPYR = ((HRPYR AND (NWEL NOT TWELL)) NOT (RFSYMBOL NOT MMSYMBOL)) NOT NMK_RNHR1000_L110E
NSHRPYR_RF = ((HRPYR AND (NWEL NOT TWELL)) AND RFSYMBOL) NOT INTERACT MMSYMBOL

PPYRES = ((PYRES NOT HRPYR ) AND PPLUS) NOT NPLUS 
NSPPYR = ((PPYRES AND SAB) NOT (RFSYMBOL NOT MMSYMBOL)) NOT NMK_RNPPO_L110E
NSPPYR_RF = ((PPYRES AND SAB) AND RFSYMBOL) NOT INTERACT MMSYMBOL

SPPYR = ((PPYRES NOT NSPPYR) NOT INTERACT SAB) NOT NMK_RSPPO_MML110E

NPYRES = (PYRES AND NPLUS) NOT PPLUS 
NSNPYR = ((NPYRES AND SAB) NOT (RFSYMBOL NOT MMSYMBOL)) NOT NMK_RNNPO_L110E
NSNPYR_RF = ((NPYRES AND SAB) AND RFSYMBOL) NOT INTERACT MMSYMBOL
SNPYR = ((NPYRES NOT NSNPYR) NOT INTERACT SAB) NOT NMK_RSNPO_MML110E

PLY1 = (PO1 NOT INTERACT PYRES) NOT INTERACT DIFF
PLY = PO1 NOT PYRES

PO1_SM_I = ( PLY AND PO1RCMK ) AND RF_STACK
PO1_SM_C = ( PLY AND RF_STACK ) NOT PO1_SM_I

//PLY_I = PLY AND RFSYMBOL
//PLY_I 	= ( PLY AND (RFSYMBOL NOT RF_STACK)) OR PO1_SM_I 
//PLY_I 	= (( PLY INTERACT (RFSYMBOL NOT RF_STACK)) NOT INTERACT MMSYMBOL ) OR PO1_SM_I
PLY_I = (((( PLY INTERACT (RFSYMBOL NOT RF_STACK)) NOT INTERACT MMSYMBOL ) OR PO1_SM_I) NOT NCAP) NOT PCAP
PLY_MOSCAP = ((PLY NOT PLY_I) NOT PLY_C) AND (NCAP OR PCAP)
#IFDEF RCFLOW_CCI
    //	PLY_C = ((((PO1 NOT PYRES) NOT PO_LVS) NOT BNGATE) NOT BPGATE) NOT RFSYMBOL
    PLY_C = (((((PLY NOT PLY_I) NOT BNGATE) NOT BPGATE) NOT ((RFSYMBOL NOT MMSYMBOL) NOT RF_STACK )) NOT NCAP) NOT PCAP

#ELSE
    #IFDEF RCFLOW_QCI
        //	PLY_C = ((((PO1 NOT PYRES) NOT PO_LVS) NOT BNGATE) NOT BPGATE) NOT RFSYMBOL
        PLY_C = (((((PLY NOT PLY_I) NOT BNGATE) NOT BPGATE) NOT ((RFSYMBOL NOT MMSYMBOL) NOT RF_STACK )) NOT NCAP) NOT PCAP

    #ELSE
         PLY_C = (((PLY NOT PLY_I) NOT ((RFSYMBOL NOT MMSYMBOL) NOT RF_STACK)) NOT NCAP) NOT PCAP

    #ENDIF
#ENDIF
// =================================================================================================
// Define P+ diffusion resistor
// =================================================================================================

PDRES = BPDIFF AND RSYMBOL
NSPSRES = (PDRES AND SAB) NOT NMK_RNPD_L110E 
SPSRES = ((PDRES NOT NSPSRES) NOT INTERACT SAB) NOT NMK_RSPD_MML110E
RPDS	 = BPDIFF NOT PDRES
PSD = RPDS NOT BPGATE


// =================================================================================================
// Define N+ diffusion resistor
// =================================================================================================

NDRES = BNDIFF AND RSYMBOL
NSNSRES = (NDRES AND SAB) NOT NMK_RNND_L110E
SNSRES = ((NDRES NOT NSNSRES) NOT INTERACT SAB) NOT NMK_RSND_MML110E 
RNDS	 = BNDIFF NOT NDRES
NSD = RNDS NOT BNGATE

//NSD_I = NSD AND RFSYMBOL
//PSD_I = PSD AND RFSYMBOL

//NSD_C = NSD NOT NSD_I
//PSD_C = PSD NOT PSD_I

NSD_C_A = NSD NOT RFSYMBOL
NSD_C_B = NSD AND MMSYMBOL
PSD_C_A = PSD NOT RFSYMBOL
PSD_C_B = PSD AND MMSYMBOL

#IFDEF CHECK_DIFF_Used_As_Conductor
    DIFF_C = (((DIFF AND ME1_C) ENCLOSE CONT) NOT PO1) NOT INTERACT RSYMBOL
    NDIFF_As_Conductor_A = ((DIFF AND NPLUS) NOT PO1) NOT INTERACT RSYMBOL
    PDIFF_As_Conductor_A = ((DIFF AND PPLUS) NOT PO1) NOT INTERACT RSYMBOL
    DIFF_CONT = (NDIFF_As_Conductor OR PDIFF_As_Conductor) AND DIFF_C
    NDIFF_As_Conductor = NDIFF_As_Conductor_A ENCLOSE DIFF_C >=2
    PDIFF_As_Conductor = PDIFF_As_Conductor_A ENCLOSE DIFF_C >=2
    
    NSD_C = ((NSD_C_A OR NSD_C_B) NOT NSDLD_D_C) NOT NDIFF_As_Conductor
    PSD_C = ((PSD_C_A OR PSD_C_B) NOT PSDLD_D_C) NOT PDIFF_As_Conductor
    
    NSD_I_S = ((NSD NOT NSD_C) INTERACT RFMOS_S) NOT NDIFF_As_Conductor
    PSD_I_S = ((PSD NOT PSD_C) INTERACT RFMOS_S) NOT PDIFF_As_Conductor
    
    NSD_I = ((NSD NOT NSD_C) NOT NSD_I_S) NOT NDIFF_As_Conductor
    PSD_I = ((PSD NOT PSD_C) NOT PSD_I_S) NOT PDIFF_As_Conductor

    NSD_MOSCAP= ((((NSD NOT NSD_C) NOT NSD_I) NOT NSD_I_S) AND NCAP) NOT NDIFF_As_Conductor
    PSD_MOSCAP= ((((PSD NOT PSD_C) NOT PSD_I) NOT PSD_I_S) AND PCAP) NOT PDIFF_As_Conductor

#ELSE
    NSD_C = (NSD_C_A OR NSD_C_B) NOT NSDLD_D_C
    PSD_C = (PSD_C_A OR PSD_C_B) NOT PSDLD_D_C
    
    NSD_I_S = (NSD NOT NSD_C) INTERACT RFMOS_S
    PSD_I_S = (PSD NOT PSD_C) INTERACT RFMOS_S
    
    NSD_I = (NSD NOT NSD_C) NOT NSD_I_S
    PSD_I = (PSD NOT PSD_C) NOT PSD_I_S

    NSD_MOSCAP= (((NSD NOT NSD_C) NOT NSD_I) NOT NSD_I_S) AND NCAP
    PSD_MOSCAP= (((PSD NOT PSD_C) NOT PSD_I) NOT PSD_I_S) AND PCAP
#ENDIF
NSDLD_D_C = (NSD INTERACT LDMOS_N) INTERACT NWEL
PSDLD_D_C = (PSD INTERACT LDMOS_P) INTERACT TWEL

//------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
// -blocking lvsLayer of RF_devices and Ncap in techgen file

//Moscap

	MOSCAP_ALL = ((((NCAPGATE_12 OR NCAPGATE_HV) OR PCAPGATE_12_TW) OR PCAPGATE_HV_TW) OR PCAPGATE_HV_PW) OR PCAPGATE_HV_PW		
	QRC_MOSCAP_BLOCKING_1 = (RFSYMBOL NOT INTERACT MOMSYMBOL) ENCLOSE MOSCAP_ALL	   				
	QRC_MOSCAP_BLOCKING_2 = (RFSYMBOL INTERACT MOMSYMBOL) AND (MMSYMBOL ENCLOSE MOSCAP_ALL)	   			
	QRC_MOSCAP_BLOCKING   = QRC_MOSCAP_BLOCKING_1 OR QRC_MOSCAP_BLOCKING_2	

//RF devices
	RF_VP345 = ((SIZE4 OR SIZE5) OR SIZE15) AND RFSYMBOL
	QRC_RF_BLOCKING = ((RFSYMBOL NOT MMSYMBOL) NOT INTERACT MOMSYMBOL) NOT INTERACT MOSCAP_ALL
	QRC_RF_MOM_BLOCKING = (((RFSYMBOL NOT MMSYMBOL) INTERACT MOMSYMBOL) INTERACT RF_VP345) NOT INTERACT MOSCAP_ALL
	
#IFDEF RCFLOW_QCI
	SCONNECT PSUB_ALL QRC_MOSCAP_BLOCKING
	SCONNECT PSUB_ALL QRC_RF_BLOCKING
	SCONNECT PSUB_ALL QRC_RF_MOM_BLOCKING
#ENDIF

// #IFDEF TOP_METAL_ME8_2T
    #IFDEF HS
        //1.2V Pwell RF NMOS //
        CONNECT ME1_I NGATE12RF BY PO_CONT
        DNGATE12RF = DIFF INTERACT NGATE12RF
        
        DEVICE N_12_HSRF DNGATE12RF NSD_I(D) PLY_I(G) NSD_I_S(S) PSUB(B) <NGATE12RF>
        [ PROPERTY NF,WF,LF
            NF = COUNT(NGATE12RF)
            WF = PERIMETER_COINCIDE(NGATE12RF,PLY_I)/(2*NF)
            LF = PERIMETER_INSIDE(NGATE12RF,PLY_I)/(2*NF)
        ]
        TRACE PROPERTY N_12_HSRF NF NF 3
        TRACE PROPERTY N_12_HSRF WF WF 3
        TRACE PROPERTY N_12_HSRF LF LF 3
        
        // 1.2V Nwell RF PMOS //
        CONNECT ME1_I PGATE12RF BY PO_CONT
        WPGATE12RF = DIFF ENCLOSE PGATE12RF
        
        DEVICE P_12_HSRF WPGATE12RF PSD_I(D) PLY_I(G) PSD_I_S(S) WEL(B) PSUB_ALL(PSUB) <PGATE12RF>
        [ PROPERTY NF,WF,LF
            NF = COUNT(PGATE12RF)
            WF = PERIMETER_COINCIDE(PGATE12RF,PLY_I)/(2*NF)
            LF = PERIMETER_INSIDE(PGATE12RF,PLY_I)/(2*NF)
        ]
        TRACE PROPERTY P_12_HSRF NF NF 3
        TRACE PROPERTY P_12_HSRF WF WF 3
        TRACE PROPERTY P_12_HSRF LF LF 3
        
        // 1.2V Triple Well RF NMOS
        CONNECT ME1_I NGATE12TWRF BY PO_CONT
        WNGATE12TWRF = TWELL ENCLOSE NGATE12TWRF
        DEVICE N_12BPW_HSRF WNGATE12TWRF NSD_I(D) TWPLY_I(G) NSD_I_S(S) TWELL(B) WEL(NW) PSUB_ALL(PSUB) <NGATE12TWRF>
        [ PROPERTY NF,WF,LF
            NF = COUNT(NGATE12TWRF)
            WF = PERIMETER_COINCIDE(NGATE12TWRF,TWPLY_I)/(2*NF)
            LF = PERIMETER_INSIDE(NGATE12TWRF,TWPLY_I)/(2*NF)
        ]
        TRACE PROPERTY N_12BPW_HSRF NF NF 3
        TRACE PROPERTY N_12BPW_HSRF WF WF 3
        TRACE PROPERTY N_12BPW_HSRF LF LF 3
        
    #ENDIF

        TRACE PROPERTY N_33BPW_RF NF NF 3
        TRACE PROPERTY N_33BPW_RF WF WF 3
        TRACE PROPERTY N_33BPW_RF LF LF 3
    #ENDIF
    
    
    #IFDEF 3.3V_HG_IO
        //3.3V Pwell RF NMOS //
        CONNECT ME1_I NGATE33RF BY PO_CONT
        DNGATE33RF = DIFF INTERACT NGATE33RF
        
        DEVICE N_33_HGRF DNGATE33RF NSD_I(D) PLY_I(G) NSD_I_S(S) PSUB(B) <NGATE33RF>
        [ PROPERTY NF,WF,LF
            NF = COUNT(NGATE33RF)
            WF = PERIMETER_COINCIDE(NGATE33RF,PLY_I)/(2*NF)
            LF = PERIMETER_INSIDE(NGATE33RF,PLY_I)/(2*NF)
        ]
        TRACE PROPERTY N_33_HGRF NF NF 3
        TRACE PROPERTY N_33_HGRF WF WF 3
        TRACE PROPERTY N_33_HGRF LF LF 3
        
        // 3.3V Nwell RF PMOS //
        CONNECT ME1_I PGATE33RF BY PO_CONT
        WPGATE33RF = DIFF ENCLOSE PGATE33RF
        
        DEVICE P_33_HGRF WPGATE33RF PSD_I(D) PLY_I(G) PSD_I_S(S) WEL(B) PSUB_ALL(PSUB) <PGATE33RF>
        [ PROPERTY NF,WF,LF
            NF = COUNT(PGATE33RF)
            WF = PERIMETER_COINCIDE(PGATE33RF,PLY_I)/(2*NF)
            LF = PERIMETER_INSIDE(PGATE33RF,PLY_I)/(2*NF)
        ]
        TRACE PROPERTY P_33_HGRF NF NF 3
        TRACE PROPERTY P_33_HGRF WF WF 3
        TRACE PROPERTY P_33_HGRF LF LF 3
        
        // 3.3V Triple Well RF NMOS
        CONNECT ME1_I NGATE33TWRF BY PO_CONT
        WNGATE33TWRF = TWELL ENCLOSE NGATE33TWRF
        DEVICE N_33BPW_HGRF WNGATE33TWRF NSD_I(D) TWPLY_I(G) NSD_I_S(S) TWELL(B) WEL(NW) PSUB_ALL(PSUB) <NGATE33TWRF>
        [ PROPERTY NF,WF,LF
            NF = COUNT(NGATE33TWRF)
            WF = PERIMETER_COINCIDE(NGATE33TWRF,TWPLY_I)/(2*NF)
            LF = PERIMETER_INSIDE(NGATE33TWRF,TWPLY_I)/(2*NF)
        ]
        TRACE PROPERTY N_33BPW_HGRF NF NF 3
        TRACE PROPERTY N_33BPW_HGRF WF WF 3
        TRACE PROPERTY N_33BPW_HGRF LF LF 3
    #ENDIF
    
// #ENDIF for 1P8M2T

// #aaaIFDEF TOP_METAL_ME8_2T 
CONNECT ME1_I VARGATE BY PO_CONT
VARMIS_RF12 = DIFF ENCLOSE ((VARGATE NOT TG) AND RFSYMBOL)
CONNECT ME1_I VARMIS_RF12 BY DIF_CONT
CONNECT ME1_MOSCAP VARGATE     BY PO_CONT
CONNECT ME1_MOSCAP VARMIS_RF12 BY DIF_CONT
DEVICE VARMIS_12_RF VARMIS_RF12 PLY_MOSCAP(PLUS) WEL(MINUS) PSUB_ALL(PSUB) <VARGATE>
[ PROPERTY LF,WF,NF//,C
    NF=COUNT(VARGATE)
    WF=PERIMETER_COINCIDE(VARGATE,PLY_MOSCAP)/(2*NF)
    LF=PERIMETER_INSIDE(VARGATE,PLY_MOSCAP)/(2*NF)
    //	 	C=11.8E-3*W*L*NF
]
TRACE PROPERTY VARMIS_12_RF LF LF 3
TRACE PROPERTY VARMIS_12_RF WF WF 3
TRACE PROPERTY VARMIS_12_RF NF NF 3

//	TRACE PROPERTY VARMIS_12_RF C C 3

VARMIS_RF33 = DIFF ENCLOSE ((VARGATE AND TG) AND RFSYMBOL)
CONNECT ME1_MOSCAP VARMIS_RF33 BY DIF_CONT

DEVICE VARMIS_33_RF VARMIS_RF33 PLY_MOSCAP(PLUS) WEL(MINUS) PSUB_ALL(PSUB) <VARGATE>
[ PROPERTY LF,WF,NF//,C
    NF=COUNT(VARGATE)
    WF=PERIMETER_COINCIDE(VARGATE,PLY_MOSCAP)/(2*NF)
    LF=PERIMETER_INSIDE(VARGATE,PLY_MOSCAP)/(2*NF)
    // 	C=4.9242*POW((L*1E6),-0.0685)*L*W*NF*1E-3
]
TRACE PROPERTY VARMIS_33_RF LF LF 3
TRACE PROPERTY VARMIS_33_RF WF WF 3
TRACE PROPERTY VARMIS_33_RF NF NF 3
//	TRACE PROPERTY VARMIS_33_RF C C 3

CONNECT ME1_I PNVAR BY DIF_CONT
VARDIOPRF = CSYMBOL ENCLOSE PNVAR

DEVICE VARDIOP_RF VARDIOPRF PNVAR(PLUS) WEL(MINUS) PSUB_ALL(PSUB)
[ PROPERTY L,WP,NF//,C
    NF=COUNT(PNVAR)
    A=AREA(PNVAR)/NF
    P=PERIMETER(PNVAR)/(2*NF)
    WP=(P-SQRT(ABS(P*P-4*A)))/2
    L=A/WP
    // 	C=0.0008957*A*NF+7.891E-11*P*2*NF+2*9E-11*L*NF
]
TRACE PROPERTY VARDIOP_RF L L 3
TRACE PROPERTY VARDIOP_RF WP WP 3
TRACE PROPERTY VARDIOP_RF NF NF 3
//	TRACE PROPERTY VARDIOP_RF C C 3

#IFDEF TOP_METAL_ME4_1T
    #IFDEF M34_MMC 
        #IFDEF 2_0FFMIM 	
            DEVICE MIMCAPS_2F_PSUB_RFKF RF_CMMC_RF MMCAL_I(PLUS) ME3_I_RFMIM(MINUS) PSUB_ALL(PSUB) <CMMC_RF> <CSYMBOL>
            CMACRO MIMPROP_RF_P CMMC_RF CSYMBOL
            TRACE PROPERTY MIMCAPS_2F_PSUB_RFKF W W capW_Tol

#IFDEF MOM6M
    SIZE4567 = ((SIZE4 OR SIZE5) OR SIZE6) OR SIZE7
    
    MOM_ARRAY_VP3_RFVCL_11 = SIZE(((SIZE4 ENCLOSE RFSYMBOL)INTERACT MOMSYMBOL ==1) NOT ((SIZE10 OR SIZE2) OR SIZE3))BY 0.8
    MOM_ARRAY_VP3_RFVCL_21 = SIZE(((SIZE4 ENCLOSE RFSYMBOL)INTERACT MOMSYMBOL ==1) AND SIZE10)BY 0.8
    MOM_ARRAY_VP3_RFVCL_31 = SIZE(((SIZE4 ENCLOSE RFSYMBOL)INTERACT MOMSYMBOL ==1) AND SIZE2)BY 0.8
    MOM_ARRAY_VP3_RFVCL_41 = SIZE(((SIZE4 ENCLOSE RFSYMBOL)INTERACT MOMSYMBOL ==1) AND SIZE3)BY 0.8
    MOM_ARRAY_VP3_RFVCL_12 = SIZE(((SIZE4 ENCLOSE RFSYMBOL)INTERACT MOMSYMBOL > 1) NOT ((SIZE10 OR SIZE2) OR SIZE3))BY 0.17
    MOM_ARRAY_VP3_RFVCL_22 = SIZE(((SIZE4 ENCLOSE RFSYMBOL)INTERACT MOMSYMBOL > 1) AND SIZE10)BY 0.17
    MOM_ARRAY_VP3_RFVCL_32 = SIZE(((SIZE4 ENCLOSE RFSYMBOL)INTERACT MOMSYMBOL > 1) AND SIZE2)BY 0.17
    MOM_ARRAY_VP3_RFVCL_42 = SIZE(((SIZE4 ENCLOSE RFSYMBOL)INTERACT MOMSYMBOL > 1) AND SIZE3)BY 0.17
    MOM_ARRAY_VP3_RFVCL_1 = MOM_ARRAY_VP3_RFVCL_11 OR MOM_ARRAY_VP3_RFVCL_12
    MOM_ARRAY_VP3_RFVCL_2 = MOM_ARRAY_VP3_RFVCL_21 OR MOM_ARRAY_VP3_RFVCL_22
    MOM_ARRAY_VP3_RFVCL_3 = MOM_ARRAY_VP3_RFVCL_31 OR MOM_ARRAY_VP3_RFVCL_32

        // start of definition DMACRO for VIL //
        DMACRO INDCHK1 LDIMETERN MENLT1 MENL MENLU N_IND_CR_N {
            <LDIMETERN> <MENLT1> <MENL> <MENLU>
            [
                PROPERTY od,NT,W,S
                P1 = PERIMETER(LDIMETERN)/2
                A = AREA(LDIMETERN)
                NT = COUNT(MENLU)+0.5
                W = PERIMETER_INSIDE(MENLT1,MENL)/(2*COUNT(MENLT1))
                S = PERIMETER_OUTSIDE(MENLU,MENL)/(2*(COUNT(MENLU)))
                od = (P1+SQRT(ABS(P1*P1-4*A)))/2 /* P1 = L1+W1 , A = L1*W1 ,L1 AND W1 are for LDIMETER */
            ]
        }
        TRACE PROPERTY L_CR12K_RFVIL_1P8M0T1F1U NT NT indNT_Tol
        TRACE PROPERTY L_CR12K_RFVIL_1P8M0T1F1U S S indS_Tol
        TRACE PROPERTY L_CR12K_RFVIL_1P8M0T1F1U W W indW_Tol
        TRACE PROPERTY L_CR12K_RFVIL_1P8M0T1F1U od od indOD_Tol
        
        DMACRO INDCHK3 LDIMETERN MENLT MENL MENLUKCT MENLT2 MENLS MENLUKCT1{
            <LDIMETERN> <MENLT> <MENL> <MENLUKCT> <MENLT2> <MENLS> <MENLUKCT1>
            [
                PROPERTY od,NT,W,S
                P1 = PERIMETER(LDIMETERN)/2
                A = AREA(LDIMETERN)
                NT = COUNT(MENLT2)
                IF(NT == 1){
                    W = PERIMETER_INSIDE(MENLT2,MENLS)
                    WS = PERIMETER_INSIDE(MENLS,MENLT2)/2
                    TS = AREA(MENLT2)/WS
                    S = (TS-3*W)/2
                }ELSE{
                    NT = (COUNT(MENLUKCT)/2)+1
                    WS = PERIMETER_INSIDE(MENLT2,MENL)/COUNT(MENLT2)
                    W = (PERIMETER_COINCIDE(MENLUKCT,MENL)-WS*COUNT(MENLUKCT))/(COUNT(MENLUKCT)*2)
                    S = (((PERIMETER_OUTSIDE(MENLUKCT1,MENLUKCT))/(2*COUNT(MENLUKCT1)))-W)/2
                }
                od = (P1+SQRT(ABS(P1*P1-4*A)))/2 /* P1 = L1+W1 , A = L1*W1 ,L1 AND W1 are for LDIMETER */
            ]
        }
        TRACE PROPERTY L_SY12KCT_RFVIL_1P8M0T1F1U NT NT indNT_Tol
        TRACE PROPERTY L_SY12KCT_RFVIL_1P8M0T1F1U S S indS_Tol
        TRACE PROPERTY L_SY12KCT_RFVIL_1P8M0T1F1U W W indW_Tol
        TRACE PROPERTY L_SY12KCT_RFVIL_1P8M0T1F1U od od indOD_Tol
        
        DMACRO INDCHK5 LDIMETERN MENLT MENL MENLUKCT MENLT2 MENLUKCT1 MEN_IND{
            <LDIMETERN> <MENLT> <MENL> <MENLUKCT> <MENLT2> <MENLUKCT1> <MEN_IND>
            [
                PROPERTY od,NT,W,S//,TM
                P1 = PERIMETER(LDIMETERN)/2
                A = AREA(LDIMETERN)
                NT = COUNT(MENLT2)
                IF(NT == 1){
                    W = PERIMETER_INSIDE(LDIMETERN,MEN_IND)/2
                    K = PERIMETER_INSIDE(MENLT2,MENL)/2
                    TS = AREA(MENLT2)/K
                    S = (TS-3*W)/2
                }ELSE{
                    NT = (COUNT(MENLUKCT)/2)+1
                    WS = PERIMETER_INSIDE(MENLT2,MENL)/COUNT(MENLT2)
                    W = (PERIMETER_COINCIDE(MENLUKCT,MENL)-WS*COUNT(MENLUKCT))/(COUNT(MENLUKCT)*2)
                    S = (((PERIMETER_OUTSIDE(MENLUKCT1,MENLUKCT))/(2*COUNT(MENLUKCT1)))-W)/2
                    TS = AREA(MENLUKCT)/W
                }
                od = (P1+SQRT(ABS(P1*P1-4*A)))/2 /* P1 = L1+W1 , A = L1*W1 ,L1 AND W1 are for LDIMETER */
            ]
        }
        TRACE PROPERTY L_SY12K_RFVIL_1P8M0T1F1U NT NT indNT_Tol
        TRACE PROPERTY L_SY12K_RFVIL_1P8M0T1F1U S S indS_Tol
        TRACE PROPERTY L_SY12K_RFVIL_1P8M0T1F1U W W indW_Tol
        TRACE PROPERTY L_SY12K_RFVIL_1P8M0T1F1U od od indOD_Tol
        // end of definition DMACRO for VIL //

        DEVICE L_SQSK_RFVIL_1P8M0T1F1U N_IND_SQ_P Lterm2(PLUS) Lterm1(MINUS) PSUB(PSUB) <SQ_DATW> <SQLDIMETER>
        <IND_SQ> <SQ_DATS> <CENTER> <SQ_NS> <SQ_BM1> <SQ_BM2> <SQ_BM3> <SQ_BM4> <SQ_BM5>
        [
            PROPERTY od,NT,W,S,NS,BM
            P1 = PERIMETER(SQLDIMETER)/2
            A = AREA(SQLDIMETER)
            od = (P1+SQRT(ABS(P1*P1-4*A)))/2 /* P1 = L1+W1 , A = L1*W1 ,L1 AND W1 are for SQLDIMETER */
            NT = COUNT(SQ_DATW)/2-0.5
            W = (PERIMETER_INSIDE(SQ_DATW,IND_SQ))/(2*COUNT(SQ_DATW))
            S = (od-PERIMETER(CENTER)/4-COUNT(SQ_DATW)*W)/(COUNT(SQ_DATW)-2)
            NS = COUNT(SQ_NS)
            BM = 1*COUNT(SQ_BM1)+2*COUNT(SQ_BM2)+3*COUNT(SQ_BM3)+4*COUNT(SQ_BM4)+5*COUNT(SQ_BM5)+COUNT(SQLDIMETER)-15
        ]
        TRACE PROPERTY L_SQSK_RFVIL_1P8M0T1F1U NT NT indNT_Tol

            DMACRO INDCHK5 LDIMETERN MENLT MENL MENLUKCT MENLT2 MENLUKCT1 MEN_IND{
                <LDIMETERN> <MENLT> <MENL> <MENLUKCT> <MENLT2> <MENLUKCT1> <MEN_IND>
                [
                    PROPERTY od,NT,W,S//,TM
                    P1 = PERIMETER(LDIMETERN)/2
                    A = AREA(LDIMETERN)
                    NT = COUNT(MENLT2)
                    IF(NT == 1){
                        W = PERIMETER_INSIDE(LDIMETERN,MEN_IND)/2
                        K = PERIMETER_INSIDE(MENLT2,MENL)/2
                        TS = AREA(MENLT2)/K
                        S = (TS-3*W)/2
                    }ELSE{
                        NT = (COUNT(MENLUKCT)/2)+1
                        WS = PERIMETER_INSIDE(MENLT2,MENL)/COUNT(MENLT2)
                        W = (PERIMETER_COINCIDE(MENLUKCT,MENL)-WS*COUNT(MENLUKCT))/(COUNT(MENLUKCT)*2)
                        S = (((PERIMETER_OUTSIDE(MENLUKCT1,MENLUKCT))/(2*COUNT(MENLUKCT1)))-W)/2
                        TS = AREA(MENLUKCT)/W
                    }
                    od = (P1+SQRT(ABS(P1*P1-4*A)))/2 /* P1 = L1+W1 , A = L1*W1 ,L1 AND W1 are for LDIMETER */
                ]
            }

                        W = PERIMETER_INSIDE(MENLT1,MENL)/(2*COUNT(MENLT1))
                        S = PERIMETER_OUTSIDE(MENLU,MENL)/(2*(COUNT(MENLU)))

                    ]
                }

                    [
                        PROPERTY od,NT,W,S

                        A = AREA(LDIMETERN)
                        NT = COUNT(MENLT2)
                        IF(NT == 1){
                            W = PERIMETER_INSIDE(MENLT2,MENLS)
                            WS = PERIMETER_INSIDE(MENLS,MENLT2)/2
                            TS = AREA(MENLT2)/WS
                            S = (TS-3*W)/2
                        }ELSE{

                            WS = PERIMETER_INSIDE(MENLT2,MENL)/COUNT(MENLT2)

                            S = (((PERIMETER_OUTSIDE(MENLUKCT1,MENLUKCT))/(2*COUNT(MENLUKCT1)))-W)/2
                            TS = AREA(MENLUKCT)/W
                        }
                        od = (P1+SQRT(ABS(P1*P1-4*A)))/2 /* P1 = L1+W1 , A = L1*W1 ,L1 AND W1 are for LDIMETER */
                    ]
                }

// ===================================================================================================================

SIZE15_OCOTF = RECTANGLE SIZE15 < 321 ASPECT == 1
SIZE15_OTF = SIZE15 NOT SIZE15_OCOTF

OTFMK 	 = ((RFSYMBOL ENCLOSE ((SIZE13 OR SIZE14) OR SIZE15)) NOT INTERACT MOMSYMBOL) NOT PWBLK

#IFDEF TOP_METAL_ME8_2T
    AL_OTF1 = (ME8 AND OTFMK) AND IND 
    OTF_term = OTFMK NOT (((SIZE4 OR SIZE5) OR SIZE6) OR SIZE7)
    
    //OTF
    OTF_SQ_1N 	 = (((OTFMK INTERACT OTF_ISQ1) INTERACT SIZE4_MET) INTERACT SIZE13) NOT INTERACT (SIZE14 OR SIZE15)
    OTF_SQ_NN 	 = (((OTFMK INTERACT OTF_ISQ1) INTERACT SIZE4_MET) INTERACT SIZE14) NOT INTERACT (SIZE13 OR SIZE15)
    OTF_SQ_N2N 	 = (((OTFMK INTERACT OTF_ISQ1) INTERACT SIZE4_MET) INTERACT SIZE15_OTF) NOT INTERACT (SIZE13 OR SIZE14)
    OTF_SQIN_1N = (((OTFMK INTERACT OTF_ISQ1) INTERACT SIZE5_MET) INTERACT SIZE13) NOT INTERACT (SIZE14 OR SIZE15)
    OTF_SQIN_NN = (((OTFMK INTERACT OTF_ISQ1) INTERACT SIZE5_MET) INTERACT SIZE14) NOT INTERACT (SIZE13 OR SIZE15)
    OTF_SQIN_N2N = (((OTFMK INTERACT OTF_ISQ1) INTERACT SIZE5_MET) INTERACT SIZE15_OTF) NOT INTERACT (SIZE13 OR SIZE14)
    OTF_SQOUT_1N = (((OTFMK INTERACT OTF_ISQ1) INTERACT SIZE6_MET) INTERACT SIZE13) NOT INTERACT (SIZE14 OR SIZE15)
    OTF_SQOUT_NN = (((OTFMK INTERACT OTF_ISQ1) INTERACT SIZE6_MET) INTERACT SIZE14) NOT INTERACT (SIZE13 OR SIZE15)
    OTF_SQOUT_N2N = (((OTFMK INTERACT OTF_ISQ1) INTERACT SIZE6_MET) INTERACT SIZE15_OTF) NOT INTERACT (SIZE13 OR SIZE14)
    OTF_SQINOUT_1N = (((OTFMK INTERACT OTF_ISQ1) INTERACT SIZE7_MET) INTERACT SIZE13) NOT INTERACT (SIZE14 OR SIZE15)
    OTF_SQINOUT_NN = (((OTFMK INTERACT OTF_ISQ1) INTERACT SIZE7_MET) INTERACT SIZE14) NOT INTERACT (SIZE13 OR SIZE15)
    OTF_SQINOUT_N2N = (((OTFMK INTERACT OTF_ISQ1) INTERACT SIZE7_MET) INTERACT SIZE15_OTF) NOT INTERACT (SIZE13 OR SIZE14)
    
    //OCOTF
    //OTF_OCCT_N2N = (((OTFMK INTERACT OTF_ISQ1) INTERACT SIZE4_MET) INTERACT SIZE15_OCOTF) NOT INTERACT (SIZE13 OR SIZE14)
    //OTF_OCCTIN_N2N = (((OTFMK INTERACT OTF_ISQ1) INTERACT SIZE5_MET) INTERACT SIZE15_OCOTF) NOT INTERACT (SIZE13 OR SIZE14)
    OTF_OCCTOUT_N2N = (( OTFMK INTERACT OTF_ISQ1) INTERACT SIZE15_OCOTF) NOT INTERACT (SIZE13 OR SIZE14)
    //OTF_OCCTINOUT_N2N = (((OTFMK INTERACT OTF_ISQ1) INTERACT SIZE7_MET) INTERACT SIZE15_OCOTF) NOT INTERACT (SIZE13 OR SIZE14)
    
    SIZE_OTF = (SIZE13 OR SIZE14) OR SIZE15
    SQLDIMETER_OTF = EXTENTS OTFMK
    OTF_MET = OTF_ISQ1 AND SIZE_OTF
    OCOTF_C1 = INT SIZE15_OCOTF < 321 REGION CENTERLINE 0.01
    OCOTF_C2 = SIZE OCOTF_C1 BY 0.01
    OCOTF_CA = SIZE (SIZE ( grow OCOTF_C2 TOP BY 0.5 BOTTOM BY 0.5 ) BY -0.02) BY 0.01 //0.03-0.04+0.01
    OCOTF_CB = SIZE (SIZE ( grow OCOTF_C2 RIGHT BY 0.5 LEFT BY 0.5 ) BY -0.02) BY 0.01
    
    MET_CONN = ((((ME8 INTERACT IND ) INTERACT RFSYMBOL) NOT INTERACT MOMSYMBOL) INTERACT SIZE15_OCOTF) NOT SIZE15_OCOTF
    OCOTF_CA1 = OCOTF_CA NOT INTERACT MET_CONN
    OCOTF_CB1 = OCOTF_CB NOT INTERACT MET_CONN
    OCOTF_CEN = OCOTF_CA1 OR OCOTF_CB1
    MET_OCOTF_A1 = SHRINK ((SIZE OCOTF_CA1 BY 16 ) AND SIZE15_OCOTF ) BOTTOM BY 32.05
    MET_OCOTF_A2 = SHRINK ((SIZE OCOTF_CB1 BY 16 ) AND SIZE15_OCOTF ) LEFT BY 32.05
    MET_OCOTF_A = MET_OCOTF_A1 OR MET_OCOTF_A2
    MET_OCOTF_W1 = MET_OCOTF_A1 AND ME8_OTF1
    MET_OCOTF_W2 = MET_OCOTF_A2 AND ME8_OTF1
    MET_OCOTF_WW = MET_OCOTF_W1 OR MET_OCOTF_W2
    MET_OCOTF_W = RECTANGLE MET_OCOTF_WW
    MET_CONN_A = MET_CONN AND (SIZE SIZE15_OCOTF BY 1)
    MET_CONN_B = SIZE( (SIZE MET_CONN_A BY 3.3) NOT SIZE15_OCOTF) BY -1 //SPACING 2~6.5
    OC_IN_A = ME8_OTF1 AND OCOTF_CEN
    OC_OUT_A = ME7_OTF1 AND OCOTF_CEN
    
    z_MET_CONN = MET_CONN AND IND
    ME8_IN = MET_CONN INTERACT (MET_CONN_B INTERACT z_MET_CONN ==2)
    ME8_OUT_1 = MET_CONN INTERACT (MET_CONN_B INTERACT z_MET_CONN ==3)
    ME8_CTS = ME8_OUT_1 INTERACT (SIZE16 NOT INTERACT LSYMBOL)
    ME8_OUT = ME8_OUT_1 NOT ME8_CTS
    
    ME8_IN_P1 = ME8_IN WITH TEXT "P1" 85 
    ME8_IN_P2 = ME8_IN WITH TEXT "P2" 85 
    ME8_OUT_S1 = ME8_OUT WITH TEXT "S1" 85 
    ME8_OUT_S2 = ME8_OUT WITH TEXT "S2" 85 
    
    CONNECT ME8_IN_P1 ME8_C
    CONNECT ME8_IN_P2 ME8_C
    CONNECT ME8_OUT_S1 ME8_C
    CONNECT ME8_OUT_S2 ME8_C
    CONNECT ME8_CTS ME8_C
    
    ME8_OTF_P1 = ME8_C AND ((SIZE (((ME8 AND OTF_term) NOT ME7) WITH TEXT "P1" 85) BY 0.02) NOT OTF_term)
    ME8_OTF_P2 = ME8_C AND ((SIZE (((ME8 AND OTF_term) NOT ME7) WITH TEXT "P2" 85) BY 0.02) NOT OTF_term)
    ME7_OTF_S1 = ME7_C AND ((SIZE (((ME7 AND OTF_term) NOT ME6) WITH TEXT "S1" 85) BY 0.02) NOT OTF_term)
    ME7_OTF_S2 = ME7_C AND ((SIZE (((ME7 AND OTF_term) NOT ME6) WITH TEXT "S2" 85) BY 0.02) NOT OTF_term)
    
    CONNECT ME8_OTF_P1 ME8_C
    CONNECT ME8_OTF_P2 ME8_C
    CONNECT ME7_OTF_S1 ME7_C
    CONNECT ME7_OTF_S2 ME7_C
#ENDIF
